# OpenEmbedWorks (Expanded Agent Context)

OpenEmbedWorks is an open engineering tools catalog optimized for browser-native workflows.

## Project purpose
The site helps engineers discover and launch web-based utilities without installation. The catalog is designed for scale using faceted search and tag-first grouping.

## Audience
- Systems and Linux engineers
- Embedded and automotive developers
- Networking and protocol engineers
- General software developers

## Data contract
Primary source file: https://openembedworks.github.io/tools-data.js

tools-data.js is a JavaScript file (not raw JSON) that assigns the catalog object to
`window.OEW_TOOLS_DATA`. This lets the site load it via a `<script>` tag, which works
identically over https://, from a local dev server, or via file:// (fetch()-based JSON
loading is blocked for file:// by browsers). To extract raw JSON programmatically,
strip the leading `window.OEW_TOOLS_DATA = ` assignment and trailing `;`.

Schema v1.0 highlights:
- _schemaVersion
- categories[]: id, label, description, order
- tags[]: id, label
- tools[]: id, name, category, tags[], description, url, optional githubRepo, rating { value, count, source }

## Discovery and ranking
- Tools can be grouped by tags and filtered by category.
- Ratings are seeded in data and may be enriched from GitHub star counts when online.

## Crawlable assets
- Home: https://openembedworks.github.io/
- Sitemap: https://openembedworks.github.io/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://openembedworks.github.io/robots.txt
- Data feed: https://openembedworks.github.io/tools-data.js

## Notes
- Some tool URLs may be placeholders while tools are being published.
- The catalog page works identically in file:// mode since tools-data.js loads as a
  <script> tag, not via fetch().
